# Core Requirements Checklist: AI Software Factory — Core Platform

**Purpose**: Standard-depth pre-implementation quality gate for `spec.md` — validates that the
28 functional requirements, 10 success criteria, 9 user stories, edge cases, and assumptions
are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and adequately cover primary/alternate/exception/
recovery/non-functional scenarios. This tests the requirements themselves, not the (not yet
written) implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for what happens to a queued/running `AgentExecution` when the `ProviderConfiguration` it depends on is deleted or deactivated? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for who may trigger a workflow stage transition versus who may only view it? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, FR-026]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the required field set for a `Client` and a `Project` documented as functional requirements, or only implied by the Key Entities section? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the Test Gate's own execution failing (e.g., the test runner crashes), as distinct from tests running and failing? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a requirement defined for whether a demand's `responsible_user_id` can be left unassigned, and what that means for workflow progression? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "without degradation" in SC-010 quantified with a specific latency, error-rate, or throughput threshold, or left open to interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "a large majority (at least 9 out of 10, sampled)" in SC-006 specific enough about sample size and sampling method to be objectively measured? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "business hours" in SC-009 defined (timezone, days, hours), or does its meaning depend on unstated context? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "a deliberate, manual action" in FR-028 specific enough to identify who performs it and through what interface, or does it leave both open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "reasonable" (implicitly, via examples like retention/error handling in Assumptions) ever left unquantified where it would materially change scope? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do FR-010/FR-011 (versions are immutable; restore creates a new version) and the Edge Cases entry on concurrent specification edits agree on the outcome when two edits are saved against the same base version at once? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the workflow state list in FR-004 (…TESTING→COMMIT…, plus FAILED) consistent with the Edge Cases entry describing a Test-Gate failure outcome, or does the Edge Cases text imply a state not named in FR-004? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the N:N artifact↔repository rules in FR-016 consistent with User Story 4's Acceptance Scenario 3 ("linked to that one repository") and the shared-repository Edge Case? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, US4, Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can User Story 3's Acceptance Scenario 2 ("differences between any two versions are shown") be objectively verified without further specifying what counts as a "difference"? [Measurability, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK015 Does User Story 9's Independent Test ("match the code host's actual state") define an acceptable staleness tolerance, given SC-008's 5-second target is scoped to demand status, not explicitly to Git data? [Measurability, Spec §US9, SC-008]
- [ ] CHK016 Does SC-004 ("unbroken traceability chain") define the minimum set of fields required for a chain to count as unbroken, or is that left to reader judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are alternate-flow requirements defined for a demand whose plan is rejected or needs rework after Analyze, before it can reach `READY_FOR_DEVELOPMENT`? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Are exception-flow requirements defined for an `AgentExecution` that is `RUNNING` when its demand is cancelled? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Key Entities AgentExecution]
- [ ] CHK019 Are recovery-flow requirements defined for resuming a Developer Agent implementation after a partial failure (some artifacts implemented, others not)? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §US6]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the spec define entry/exit conditions for the `BLOCKED` state named in FR-004, given no acceptance scenario or edge case currently describes one? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §FR-004]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Is there a requirement for two artifacts in the same demand both claiming the same file? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK022 Is there a requirement for a Pull Request the platform created being closed or merged manually outside the platform? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §US9]
- [ ] CHK023 Is there a requirement for a user's RBAC role changing while they are the responsible party on an in-progress demand? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-026]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are data-retention requirements defined for `SpecificationVersion` and `AuditLog` records, or only noted as an open follow-up with no owner or timeline? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Does FR-026 specify enough about RBAC to derive a permission matrix, or does it only assert that role-gating must exist without naming any role? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-026, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Is SC-009's "business hours, best-effort" availability requirement paired with any requirement for how users are informed during a maintenance window? [Gap, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK027 Are localization or accessibility requirements addressed anywhere in the spec, or explicitly marked out of scope? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption that "Client and Project management... exist prior to demand intake" backed by any functional requirement describing how a Client/Project is created, or left entirely implicit? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the platform's reliance on the external demand source's own `external_id` stability (underpinning FR-028's uniqueness rule) documented as an explicit assumption? [Gap, Assumption, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK030 Is there a named next step for resolving the RBAC permission matrix deferred in Assumptions, given plan.md's Constitution Check also references RBAC Guards without defining the matrix? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 Does FR-019 ("branch naming policy... configurable per project") specify the outcome when two projects sharing one repository configure conflicting naming policies? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK032 Is FR-028 ("no automatic re-sync after import") consistent with, or does it need to be cross-referenced from, the Edge Case describing deliberate reprocessing of a specification stage after upstream changes? [Conflict-check, Spec §FR-028, Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Focus area: Core requirements (spec.md), Standard depth — user-selected via `/speckit-checklist`'s clarifying questions.
- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add findings/decisions inline as you resolve each item; items resolved by adding text to spec.md should be marked complete and cite the new section.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001-CHK032) for easy reference; a future `/speckit-checklist` run for a different domain (e.g., `security.md`, `api.md`) starts its own CHK sequence in its own file.
